date.as_written: kāmaśaraikabhūtasahite naipālike hāyane ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bhādrapade ’site ravidine ṛkṣe tathā sraṣṭari madhyāhne

notes: Historical marginal/post-colophonic record commemorating the death of King Sthitirājamalla (Jayasthiti Malla) on Bhādrapada kṛṣṇa 6, Sunday, NS 515 (chronogram: kāmaśara [5] - eka [1] - bhūta [5] = 515).
